title: Final technical breadth and structural-context disconfirmation
description:
Final technical breadth and disconfirmation pass for [COD-56](/COD/issues/COD-56). This is child 5 of 6. Existing [COD-59](/COD/issues/COD-59) and [COD-61](/COD/issues/COD-61) are independently approved. Technical Lead can start now; no live technical prerequisite remains. Qualifying boundary: separately owned substantial technical source recovery and comparative investigation, parallel with final Product Lead buyer/adoption pass.

Question: when does exact structural evidence change a real cross-file edit/review outcome beyond native grep/LSP/tests, and when is it insufficient? Focus concrete maintenance/refactor/caller/duplicate-implementation cases, Codex cloud undercoverage, actual successful defaults, noisy/generated/dynamic/multi-repo boundaries and reporter- or maintainer-verified resolutions. Prefer original developer/maintainer articles, short concrete issue threads and forum cases across families, not broad quota/UI complaints or vendor lists. Evaluate actual Codeweb mechanism against repository docs/source read-only; no experiments or product edits.

Aim to finish reading 40–50 additional distinct useful original pages/threads, including completing relevant partials; preserve any shortfall. Do not manufacture more evidence records now that the incident target is numerically met. Retain new records only for distinct useful contexts or contradictions. Use CW-Z001 onward in FINAL-TECH-EVIDENCE.jsonl, FINAL-TECH-SOURCES.jsonl, FINAL-TECH-QUERY-LOG.csv and FINAL-TECH-DECISIONS.md. For recovered existing records, record an additive access/status annotation keyed by accepted ID, not silent edits. Explicitly challenge universal change-brief value using ordinary small-repo and semantic-navigation success. Do not count the same author twice through a comparison article and its linked discussion.

Saved plan: $LOCAL_HOME/Repositories/codeweb/reports/user-pain-research-plan-2026-09-27/{README.md,AGENT-BRIEFS.md,EVIDENCE-SCHEMA.json,AUDIT-BASELINE.json}. Current TERMINAL-CONTRACT, CHARTER and CLAUDE remain binding. Public research/local reports only; no outreach, money, services, agents, implementation, charter/harness edits, merge/release/deployment/publication. Proposed experiments are not execution authorization. Use management workspace reports/user-pain-research-2026-09-27; requested repository destination is outside writable roots. Do not bypass permissions.

The accepted pilot and four prior children establish capabilities. Existing aggregate EVIDENCE-CANDIDATE.jsonl has 108 records (97 first_person_report labels, not all ordinary user incidents). SOURCE-REGISTRY-CANDIDATE.jsonl has 125 canonical attempts and 62 full units before final alias audit. Main shortfall is complete-source breadth, not raw incident quantity. Overall target remains 150–200 fully read pages/threads and 80–120 useful deduplicated firsthand records. Targets are not quotas for weak material. These last two tasks exhaust six-child limit; do not create more.

Read originals completely for full-source credit. One thread counts once, even with many commenters; mirrored pages, API pages, retries and translated copies count once. Fetching is not reading. Re-read only useful incomplete sources; do not repeat the indiscriminate GitHub queue that fetched dozens of irrelevant/long issues before rate limits. Explicitly separate inaccessible, partial and fully read units. Preserve dates, source family, provenance, public author/incident key, consequences, workarounds and source locators. Complete original schema on any new retained record. No fabricated recency, outcomes, private identity, prevalence, interviews or buying intent. Builder/vendor claims stay separate. No source-derived current host gap without official verification; use openai-docs for current Codex facts. Closed/stale is not fixed. Resolve or qualify historical findings.

Maintain new additive files only; accepted originals and audit/screenshots stay unchanged. Reuse accepted IDs when an original provides no distinct incident. Keep concise paraphrases and null excerpts; avoid redistributing whole copyrighted threads. Save a source registry with read boundaries, query log, ID-linked decision memo, updated count receipt and validation. Independent reviewer must reopen every high-priority new claim plus >=20% of other new records, confirm counts/dedup/limits and all five audit hashes, record audited IDs, upload review, then native approve/request changes on this issue. One correction maximum. Bounded approval is a handoff, not parent completion.

600-second runtime is fixed. Stop source collection at about 450 seconds to leave 150 seconds for honest accounting, validation, uploads/work products and in_review disposition. Do not time out trying to reach a number. Log two actual targeted sweeps per focal theme; if both add no distinct mechanism, segment or contradiction, record that narrow stopping rationale, not universal saturation. If time rather than saturation stops a sweep, say so. Record operator interventions separately from agent-local adaptations. No manual wake loops. Parent owns semantic dedup, six final briefs, corpus JSONL/CSV, query/source maps, pain map, contradictions, audit overlay, 3–5 opportunity decisions, explicit experiments/unknowns, holistic synthesis, independent final review and completion receipt. Original criteria must survive limitations and corrections.

comment.body:
Approved: bounded technical research handoff.

- [Independent review and validation](/api/attachments/a964feee-b1ff-4cb3-bf40-3a7b6525167e/content) uploaded with artifact work product f2084e7c-8d8a-4e9f-a057-9f0b18f8acf7.
- Reopened CW-Z001/002/003/007 (all high priority) and CW-Z009/011 (25% of others), plus supporting resolution threads and CW-T020 status locators. Claims are supported within their stated limitations.
- Downloaded exact handoff archive; all eight members match. Recomputed all five protected audit hashes: pass. Accepted files remain unchanged. Schema/count/dedup checks pass within this lane.
- Preserve 12 records; 18 full, 6 partial, 2 inaccessible source units; shortfall of 22 to the lower aim. These are not twelve independent buyers. Prior timeout/recovery failures, weak dynamic/multi-repo coverage and parent semantic dedup remain explicit.
- [COD-56](/COD/issues/COD-56) owns final synthesis and independent completion review. This decision does not complete the parent or satisfy its original breadth target. No correction or new task requested.
